name: watermarks-remover
description: Inspect and clean AI provenance metadata and invisible Unicode from content you own.

author.name: watermarks-remover contributors; marketplace packaging by research-toolkit maintainers

interface.shortDescription: Clean AI provenance metadata and invisible text marks from owned content.
interface.longDescription: Provides remove-ai-marks for deterministic cleanup of invisible Unicode and C2PA, EXIF, XMP, and container metadata in owned text and files. Python 3.10+ is required; optional external tools remain opt-in.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this file for provenance metadata and invisible Unicode, then clean a copy if appropriate.
